item.tib: zhang zhung snyan rgyud kyi rtsa rlung geg sel 'khrul 'khor gyi rim pa
item.coloph: yon tan stod 'tshang snying rlung dang*/ snying mi dga' ba'i nad las grol/ dam pa 'bum rjes mdzad pa yin/ rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud kyi/ rtsa ba bye brag 'khrul 'khor rim pa ni/ dpon rgyal btsan pos mdzad nas/ rim gyis brgyud nas da lta bdag la'o//
